title: Dealing in Securities Policy

tiers.name: Origin Personnel
tiers.description: All Origin Directors, employees and people working for Origin under a contract or consultancy agreement. All substantive prohibitions (closed periods, short-term dealing, short selling, margin lending, secured financing, hedging of unvested plan securities) apply to this tier without differentiation.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Origin Directors; distinguished only for clearance (Chairman and Company Secretary) and post-trade confirmation of price and quantity to the Company Secretary.

tiers.name: ELT & ELT Direct Reports
tiers.description: Executive Leadership Team and their direct reports; distinguished only for clearance (Manager and Company Secretary).

tiers.name: All other employees
tiers.description: Employees below ELT direct reports; distinguished only for clearance (Manager).

tiers.name: Associates
tiers.description: Spouse or de facto partner, dependent children, companies/partnerships/trusts over which the person (alone or with those persons) has control or significant influence, and anyone acting in concert on a Dealing. Excludes adults who deal completely independently.

definitions.hedging_definition: instruments or other financial products which operate to limit the economic risk of any Securities issued to you under any equity incentive schemes provided by Origin

windows.end_anchor: second trading day after the announcement of Origin's results for the financial year ended 30 June
second trading day after the announcement of Origin's results for the half financial year ended 31 December

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: Company Secretary, in conjunction with the Chief Executive Officer, may impose and lift an 'Additional Prohibition' due to activity or knowledge within Origin. Confidential: it is unlikely to be announced; a person requesting clearance may be told on a confidential basis that a prohibition exists but not why or for how long.

rules.detail: No express derivatives rule. Creating a derivative over Securities, and buying or selling financial products created over or in respect of Securities, are Dealings; Securities includes derivatives and any financial product with no venue limit, so an OTC put/call is a Dealing requiring prior written clearance and is barred in Closed Periods, Additional Prohibitions and while holding Inside Information.
rules.evidence: buy or sell Securities or financial products issued or created over, or in respect of Securities ... create a derivative over Securities

rules.detail: Absolute ban on instruments limiting economic risk of equity incentive scheme securities while subject to performance hurdles or otherwise unvested.
rules.evidence: You must not Deal in instruments or other financial products which operate to limit the economic risk of any Securities issued to you under any equity incentive schemes provided by Origin while those holdings are subject to performance hurdles or are otherwise unvested.

rules.detail: Hedging arrangements over vested plan securities are expressly contemplated and must comply with the Policy, i.e. prior written clearance, outside Closed Periods/Additional Prohibitions, no Inside Information. The policy does not distinguish vested-but-locked shares; hedging of non-plan shares is not named and is caught only as a Dealing.
rules.evidence: Any sale, hedging arrangement or other Dealing involving those Securities after they have vested must be done in compliance with this Policy.

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named. A prepaid forward or similar is a Dealing (financial product in respect of Securities; agreement to sell) requiring clearance. Any monetisation that takes security over Origin Securities is a secured financing arrangement prohibited by 7.1.
rules.evidence: enter into an agreement to do any of the above, and Deal has a corresponding meaning.

rules.detail: Outright ban; short selling is also listed within the Dealing definition as a short-term trade.
rules.evidence: You must not engage in short-selling Origin Securities.

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named anywhere and is not listed in the Dealing definition.

CFDs are not named. They are financial products in respect of Securities and so a Dealing requiring clearance, but a CFD would in practice fall within the ban on short-term or speculative Dealing and, if short, the short-selling ban.
rules.evidence: You must not Deal in Origin’s Securities on a short-term or speculative basis.

rules.detail: Margin loans using Origin Securities as collateral, solely or as part of a portfolio, are banned from the date of the Policy. A lender's forced sale in a Closed Period or other prohibited time is a serious breach.
rules.evidence: From the date of this Policy, you must not enter into margin lending arrangements using Origin Securities (either solely or as part of a portfolio) as security as a collateral against repayment of a loan, or enter into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of Origin Securities.

rules.detail: Granting security over Origin Securities to support any financing is prohibited as a 'secured financing arrangement'. A charge or lien unconnected to a financing is not named and is not a Dealing under the definition.
rules.evidence: or enter into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of Origin Securities.

rules.detail: Blanket ban on any secured financing in respect of Origin Securities, not limited to margin loans; no tier, security-state or approval carve-out and no exemption authority.
rules.evidence: or enter into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of Origin Securities.

rules.detail: Intention test: no acquisition with intent to dispose within three months, and no arrangements that result in short-term Dealing (margin loans given as an example). Carve-out for securities acquired on exercise of plan options/rights and shares acquired under employee equity incentive schemes.
rules.evidence: You must not acquire Origin’s Securities with the intention of disposing or selling them within three months of acquisition, or enter into arrangements which result in short-term Dealing (such as margin loans) to minimise the perception of speculative trading.

clearance.post_trade_to: Company Secretary (confirmation of price and quantity)
clearance.evidence: Any transaction should be completed within 2 business days of receiving clearance and must be consistent with the terms of that clearance. Following a Dealing of Securities by a Director, confirmation of price and quantity must be provided to the Company Secretary
you must comply with the prior written clearance requirement set out below before you can Deal.
you must comply with the prior written clearance requirement set out below before you can Deal.

carve_outs: Securities acquired as a result of the exercise of an option or similar rights under Origin's employee equity incentive schemes
shares acquired under Origin's employee equity incentive schemes
short_term.evidence: You must not acquire Origin’s Securities with the intention of disposing or selling them within three months of acquisition

exceptions.evidence: the transaction results in no change in the beneficial interest in the Securities;
the transaction occurs via instruments in a scheme or other arrangement where the investment decisions are exercised by a third party;
you have no control or influence with respect to trading decisions;
the transaction occurs under an offer to all or most of Origin’s shareholders.
acquisition of Securities through a dividend reinvestment plan, share purchase plan, rights issue or under a disclosure document;
the exercise (but not any other Dealing of Securities following exercise) of options or a right under an employee equity incentive scheme.

exemption_authority: None. Dealing during a Closed Period or Additional Prohibition 'will not be permitted' (8.2) and there is no hardship or discretionary waiver; the Board approves only material changes to the Policy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: A sale of your Origin Securities by a third party outside your control (such as a margin lender) in a Closed Period or when you are otherwise prohibited by this Policy is a serious breach of this Policy and may result in dismissal.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Even if a secured facility existed, the bank's enforcement or physical settlement of the collar during a Closed Period would put the executive in serious breach, so the structure cannot rely on lender enforcement rights.

bespoke_clauses.clause: From the date of this Policy, you must not ... enter into any other secured financing arrangements in respect of Origin Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded collar, secured on the collared shares, is expressly prohibited for all personnel and Associates regardless of vesting state, with no approval route; the wording is prospective only and is silent on unwinding pre-existing arrangements.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Dealing in Origin Securities during a Closed Period or Additional Prohibitions will not be permitted.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: No hardship or exceptional-circumstances exemption exists, so collar entry, unwind, roll or settlement must fall entirely within open windows.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If you come to possess Inside Information after receiving clearance to Deal, you must not complete the trade.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A cleared collar must be priced and executed within the 2-business-day validity and can become unexecutable if inside information arises before signing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If you hold Origin Securities, you must recognise that a prohibition may apply at the time you wish to sell them, and Origin will have no responsibility to you.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Undisclosed Additional Prohibitions can block delivery or unwind of shares under the collar at any time, and the executive bears that risk.

bespoke_clauses.clause: You must not ... enter into arrangements which result in short-term Dealing (such as margin loans) to minimise the perception of speculative trading.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A short-dated collar or one with early-termination triggers may be characterised as an arrangement resulting in short-term Dealing, so tenor should exceed three months.

bespoke_clauses.clause: This Policy also extends to Associates of Origin Personnel. ... a company, partnership or trust over which: (i) you have control or significant influence
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Routing the collar or loan through a family trust or controlled company does not escape the secured financing ban or clearance requirement.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Securities: ... any financial product; derivatives ... Dealing: ... create a derivative over Securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: There is no venue limitation, so an OTC put and call with a bank is squarely a Dealing subject to clearance and windows.

summary: A funded collar is not possible under this policy. The unfunded derivative legs (purchased put and written call) over vested shares are a Dealing that Directors may enter with prior written clearance from the Chairman and Company Secretary (Manager and Company Secretary for ELT and their direct reports), executed within 2 business days, outside the 1 July and 1 January Closed Periods and any confidential Additional Prohibition, and not over plan securities that remain unvested or subject to performance hurdles. However, section 7.1 expressly bans margin lending and any other secured financing arrangement in respect of Origin Securities for all personnel and their Associates, with no exemption authority, so a loan secured on the collared shares is prohibited outright. A lender's forced sale in a Closed Period is a serious breach that may lead to dismissal, and there is no hardship relief. Tenor should exceed three months to avoid the short-term dealing ban, and any unwind or settlement is itself a Dealing requiring fresh clearance.
